message.content: {"note_claim": "The Columbia disaster killed all seven crew members aboard when the Space Shuttle broke up on reentry, and a photograph of that breakup was used in the post.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "On February 1, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated as it re-entered the atmosphere over Texas and Louisiana , killing all seven astronauts on board.", "reason": "The page directly substantiates the Columbia breakup and the deaths of all seven crew, and its infobox shows a grayscale FLIR photo of the breakup, though it can't confirm the post used that image."}

parsed.note_claim: The Columbia disaster killed all seven crew members aboard when the Space Shuttle broke up on reentry, and a photograph of that breakup was used in the post.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On February 1, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated as it re-entered the atmosphere over Texas and Louisiana , killing all seven astronauts on board.
